lines.text: I dreamed my mother held a secret in her hands
Something small and shining she was scared to plan
We talked like it was promised, like the house could grow
I saw a future I was never meant to know
For a minute it was easy
For a minute it was true
I had a name inside my mouth
I never got to give to you
You were almost here
Almost breathing in the quiet
Almost part of us
Then the morning took the light
I woke up empty-handed
With a love that had no name
You were almost here
And it hurt me just the same
I watched her smile like hope had finally come home
After all the years of learning how to live alone
I reached for something living in a room that wasn’t real
And I felt the kind of joy you’re not supposed to steal
For a minute it was easy
For a minute it was true
I had a name inside my mouth
I never got to give to you
You were almost here
Almost breathing in the quiet
Almost part of us
Then the morning took the light
I woke up empty-handed
With a love that had no name
You were almost here
And it hurt me just the same
I know it was a dream
I know you were never mine
But grief don’t ask permission
When it borrows you from time
I held you in the dark
Then the dark gave you back
You were almost here
Almost breathing in the quiet
Almost part of us
Then the morning took the light
I woke up empty-handed
With a love that had no name
You were almost here
And it hurt me just the same
Almost here…
